NPT , ECO
, Aug. 16, 2018 The Conference Board Leading Economic Index ® (LEI) for the U.K. decreased 0.2 percent in June 2018 to 96.7 (2016=100).
® (CEI) for the U.K. remained unchanged in June 2018 at 102.3 (2016=100).
